part4.script: Hello, this message is for Mr. Gregory Shaw. This is Linda calling from Westfield Family Dental. I'm calling to remind you about your cleaning appointment with Dr. Patel this Thursday at nine-thirty in the morning. Please note that our clinic has moved since your last visit. We're now located at four-twenty Harbor Avenue, on the second floor of the Lakeside Medical Building. Parking is available in the garage behind the building, and we'll validate your ticket at the front desk. Also, because this is your first visit with us this year, we ask that you complete a short health questionnaire before your visit. You can find it on our Web site. If you need to change your appointment, please call us at least twenty-four hours in advance. Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.

part4.script: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Halvorsen Museum of Natural History. My name is Priya, and I'll be your guide for the next ninety minutes. We'll begin here in the Hall of Oceans, where you can see a life-size model of a blue whale hanging from the ceiling. After that, we'll head upstairs to our newest exhibit on ancient forests, which opened just last month. Before we start, a quick reminder: photography is allowed throughout the museum, but please turn off your camera's flash, since bright light can damage some of the older specimens. At the end of the tour, we'll stop by the gift shop, where you can use the discount coupon in your welcome packet for fifteen percent off any purchase. All right, let's get started.

part4.script: Before we wrap up today's meeting, I want to share some news about our Riverside factory. As you know, we've been having trouble keeping up with orders for our outdoor furniture collection. Well, management has approved the purchase of two new cutting machines, which should increase our production capacity by about thirty percent. The machines will be installed at the beginning of next month. Now, I know what some of you are thinking. Learning to operate new equipment takes time. That's why the manufacturer is sending a specialist to train our staff on-site for a full week. Sign-up sheets for the training sessions are posted in the break room. Space is limited. part4.script: You're listening to WRKT Community Radio. In local news, the Brookfield City Library will reopen its main branch on Saturday after an eight-month renovation. The updated building features a larger children's area, quiet study rooms that can be reserved online, and a recording studio where residents can create their own audio programs free of charge. Library director Howard Lim says the renovation was funded largely through donations from local businesses. To celebrate the reopening, the library is hosting an open house from ten a.m. to three p.m. on Saturday, with guided tours of the building every hour. Because parking near the library is expected to be limited, city officials are encouraging visitors to take the bus. Route nine stops right in front of the main entrance. Coming up after the break, we'll have the weekend weather forecast.

I spoke with our chef about your request to replace the beef dish with a seafood option, and she's happy to do that. She's suggesting grilled salmon with a lemon herb sauce. The only issue is the price. Seafood costs us more, so the per-person rate would go up by about four dollars. I know you mentioned that the budget was already approved. If you'd like, I could e-mail you a couple of other options that wouldn't change the price, such as a chicken dish our clients really enjoy. Also, we'll need your final guest count by next Wednesday so we can order ingredients. Please give me a call back at five five five, two one eight four.

Reviewer: Daniel Fortier | Rating: 4 out of 5 stars

I hired Swift Hands Movers last Saturday to move from a two-bedroom apartment to a small house across town. Because I had already packed everything myself, I didn't need the packing service, but I did need help taking apart and putting back together our bed frames and a large dining table. My only complaint concerns the bill. I booked online three weeks ahead, so I received the discount I expected, but I was surprised by an additional charge I hadn't noticed when I made the reservation. Next time, I would schedule my move during the week. Still, I would recommend this company to anyone.

=== PASSAGE 1: ARTICLE ===
Kingsley Farmers Market to Move and Expand

KINGSLEY (February 20) — After twelve years in the parking lot of the Kingsley Public Library, the city's Saturday farmers market will move to the newly renovated Riverside Plaza this spring. The new site can accommodate up to 80 vendor stalls, nearly double the current number.

The market's first day at Riverside Plaza will be Saturday, April 5. Hours will be extended to 8:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M., one hour longer than before. In addition, the market will now operate on Wednesday evenings from 4:00 to 7:00 P.M. from June through September.

"Our vendors have asked for more space for years," said market manager Teresa Holm. "Riverside Plaza also has covered areas, so we will no longer have to cancel the market on rainy days." Vendor applications for the new season are being accepted until March 10.

===
=== PASSAGE 2: FORM ===
Kingsley Farmers Market — Vendor Application (Season: April–November)
Business name: Hollow Creek Honey
Contact: Marcus Bell | Phone: 555-0172
Products: Raw honey, beeswax candles, honey-based skin care products

Stall type requested (check one):
[ ] Standard stall, uncovered (10 ft × 10 ft) — $25 per market day
[X] Standard stall, covered (10 ft × 10 ft) — $35 per market day
[ ] Double stall, covered (10 ft × 20 ft) — $60 per market day

Market days (check all that apply): [X] Saturdays [X] Wednesdays (June–September)

Note: Vendors selling food products must attach a copy of a valid county food-handling permit. Electricity is available at covered stalls only, for an additional $5 per day.

Date submitted: March 3

===
=== PASSAGE 3: E-MAIL ===
To: Marcus Bell <mbell@hollowcreekhoney.com>
From: Teresa Holm <tholm@kingsleymarket.org>
Date: March 18
Subject: Your vendor application

Dear Mr. Bell,

Thank you for applying to sell at the Kingsley Farmers Market this season. I am pleased to inform you that your application has been approved. However, all of the covered single stalls have already been assigned. I can offer you an uncovered stall on the east side of the plaza, near the main entrance, which gets a great deal of foot traffic. Alternatively, a covered double stall is still available if you would like to share it with another vendor and split the cost.

We have received your county permit, but please note that it expires on May 31. Kindly send us a copy of your renewed permit before then.

Best regards,
Teresa Holm
Market Manager
